Name: Idli with Sambar
Ingredients: 4 ladles Idli batter | 1 cup Sambar | 1 tsp Oil
Steps: Grease the idli plates and pour in the batter. | Steam for 10 to 12 minutes on the stove. | Serve hot with sambar.

Name: Ven Pongal
Ingredients: 1/2 cup Rice | 1/4 cup Moong dal | 1 tsp Pepper | 1 tsp Cumin seeds | 1 tbsp Ghee | 1 inch Ginger | Curry leaves | Salt to taste
Steps: Wash rice and dal, add 3 cups water and pressure cook for 4 whistles. | Heat ghee, add pepper, cumin, ginger and curry leaves. | Mix the tempering into the pongal, add salt and serve.

Name: Rava Upma
Ingredients: 1/2 cup Rava | 1 Onion, chopped | 1 Green chilli | 1 tsp Mustard seeds | 1 tbsp Oil | Curry leaves | Salt to taste
Steps: Dry roast the rava and keep aside. | Heat oil, add mustard, curry leaves, onion and chilli. | Add 1 cup water and salt, bring to a boil. | Stir in the rava and cook for 2 minutes.

Name: Bread Omelette
Ingredients: 2 Eggs | 2 slices Bread | 1 Onion, chopped | 1 Green chilli | 1 tsp Butter | Salt to taste
Steps: Beat the eggs with onion, chilli and salt. | Pour onto a hot buttered pan and place the bread slices on top. | Flip, fold and cook till golden.

Name: Aval Upma
Ingredients: 1 cup Aval | 1 Onion, chopped | 1 tsp Mustard seeds | 1/4 tsp Turmeric powder | 1 tbsp Oil | 1 Lemon | Salt to taste
Steps: Rinse the aval and drain. | Temper mustard in oil, add onion and turmeric. | Add aval and salt, mix and cook for 3 minutes. | Squeeze lemon and serve.

Name: Masala Dosa
Ingredients: 2 ladles Dosa batter | 2 Potatoes, boiled | 1 Onion, sliced | 1 tsp Mustard seeds | 1 tbsp Oil | Salt to taste
Steps: Mash the potatoes and cook with onion, mustard and salt. | Spread batter thin on a hot tawa and drizzle oil. | Fill with potato masala, fold and serve.

Name: Ragi Dosa
Ingredients: 1/2 cup Ragi flour | 2 tbsp Rice flour | 1 Onion, chopped | 1 Green chilli | Salt to taste
Steps: Mix the flours with water, onion, chilli and salt to a thin batter. | Pour onto a hot tawa and cook both sides till crisp.

Name: Egg Dosa
Ingredients: 2 ladles Dosa batter | 2 Eggs | 1/2 tsp Pepper | Salt to taste
Steps: Spread the batter on a hot tawa. | Break an egg on top, spread it and sprinkle pepper and salt. | Cook till the egg sets and serve.

Name: Pesarattu
Ingredients: 1 cup Moong dal, soaked | 1 inch Ginger | 2 Green chillies | 1 Onion, chopped | Salt to taste
Steps: Grind moong dal, ginger and chillies in the mixie. | Spread on a hot tawa, sprinkle onion and cook both sides.

Name: Poori with Potato Masala
Ingredients: 1 cup Wheat flour | 2 Potatoes, boiled | 1 Onion, sliced | 1 tsp Mustard seeds | Oil for frying | Salt to taste
Steps: Knead flour with water and salt into a stiff dough. | Cook potato with onion and mustard into a masala. | Roll small pooris and fry till they puff up.

Name: Lemon Rice with Egg Podimas
Ingredients: 1 cup Cooked rice | 1 Lemon | 2 Eggs | 1 Onion, chopped | 1 tsp Mustard seeds | 1/4 tsp Turmeric powder | 1 tbsp Oil | Salt to taste
Steps: Temper mustard and turmeric in oil, mix in rice, lemon juice and salt. | Scramble the eggs with onion and salt for the podimas. | Serve the rice with the podimas.

Name: Egg Kulambu
Ingredients: 3 Eggs, boiled | 1 Onion, sliced | 1 Tomato, chopped | 1 small ball Tamarind | 1.5 tbsp Kulambu powder | 2 tbsp Oil | Curry leaves | Salt to taste
Steps: Soak tamarind in warm water and extract the juice. | Saute onion and tomato in oil with curry leaves. | Add kulambu powder, tamarind water and salt and simmer 10 minutes. | Add the eggs and simmer 5 more minutes. Serve with rice.

Name: Sambar Rice
Ingredients: 1/2 cup Rice | 1/4 cup Toor dal | 1 cup Mixed vegetables | 1 small ball Tamarind | 2 tbsp Sambar powder | 1 tbsp Ghee | Salt to taste
Steps: Pressure cook rice, dal and vegetables together for 4 whistles. | Add tamarind water, sambar powder and salt and boil 5 minutes. | Finish with ghee.

Name: Curd Rice with Egg Fry
Ingredients: 1 cup Cooked rice | 1/2 cup Curd | 2 Eggs | 1/2 tsp Chilli powder | 1 tsp Mustard seeds | 1 tbsp Oil | Salt to taste
Steps: Mash rice with curd and salt, temper with mustard. | Fry the eggs sunny side up and sprinkle chilli powder. | Serve together.

Name: Tomato Rice
Ingredients: 1 cup Rice | 3 Tomatoes, chopped | 1 Onion, sliced | 1 tsp Chilli powder | 1 tbsp Oil | Salt to taste
Steps: Saute onion and tomatoes with chilli powder. | Add rice, 2 cups water and salt and pressure cook for 2 whistles.

Name: Vegetable Biryani
Ingredients: 1 cup Basmati rice | 1 cup Mixed vegetables | 1 Onion, sliced | 1/2 cup Curd | 1 tbsp Biryani masala | 1 tbsp Ghee | Mint leaves | Salt to taste
Steps: Saute onion, vegetables and masala in ghee. | Add curd, mint, rice, 2 cups water and salt. | Pressure cook for 2 whistles and rest 10 minutes.

Name: Chettinad Egg Curry
Ingredients: 4 Eggs, boiled | 2 Onions, sliced | 2 Tomatoes, chopped | 2 tbsp Chettinad masala | 1/4 cup Coconut, grated | 2 tbsp Oil | Salt to taste
Steps: Grind coconut with the masala in the mixie. | Saute onion and tomato, add the paste, water and salt. | Simmer 10 minutes, add eggs and cook 5 more minutes.

Name: Rasam Rice with Omelette
Ingredients: 1 cup Cooked rice | 1 Tomato | 1 small ball Tamarind | 1 tbsp Rasam powder | 2 Eggs | 1 Onion, chopped | 1 tsp Oil | Salt to taste
Steps: Boil tomato, tamarind water, rasam powder and salt for 8 minutes. | Make an omelette with eggs, onion and salt. | Serve rasam over rice with the omelette.

Name: Chapati with Veg Kurma
Ingredients: 1 cup Wheat flour | 1 cup Mixed vegetables | 1/4 cup Coconut, grated | 1 tbsp Kurma masala | 1 Onion, sliced | 1 tbsp Oil | Salt to taste
Steps: Knead the flour into a soft dough and rest. | Grind coconut with kurma masala. | Cook onion and vegetables, add the paste and water and simmer. | Roll and cook chapatis on a tawa.

Name: Chapati with Chana Masala
Ingredients: 1 cup Wheat flour | 1 cup Chana, soaked | 2 Onions, chopped | 2 Tomatoes, chopped | 1 tbsp Chana masala | 1 tbsp Oil | Salt to taste
Steps: Pressure cook chana for 5 whistles. | Saute onion and tomato with chana masala, add chana and simmer. | Roll and cook chapatis.

Name: Rava Dosa
Ingredients: 1/2 cup Rava | 1/4 cup Rice flour | 2 tbsp Maida | 1 Onion, chopped | 1 tsp Cumin seeds | Salt to taste
Steps: Mix everything with water into a thin batter and rest 10 minutes. | Pour onto a very hot tawa from a height and cook till crisp.

Name: Idli with Tomato Chutney
Ingredients: 4 ladles Idli batter | 2 Tomatoes | 1 Onion | 2 Dry red chillies | 1 tsp Oil | Salt to taste
Steps: Steam the idlis for 10 to 12 minutes. | Saute tomato, onion and chillies, grind to a chutney with salt. | Serve together.

Name: Egg Fried Rice
Ingredients: 1 cup Cooked rice | 2 Eggs | 1/2 cup Mixed vegetables | 1 tsp Soy sauce | 1 tsp Pepper | 1 tbsp Oil | Salt to taste
Steps: Scramble the eggs in hot oil. | Add vegetables and stir fry 2 minutes. | Add rice, soy sauce, pepper and salt and toss on high heat.

Name: Paneer Butter Masala with Roti
Ingredients: 200 g Paneer | 2 Tomatoes | 1 Onion | 1 tbsp Butter | 2 tbsp Cream | 1 tsp Garam masala | 1 cup Wheat flour | Salt to taste
Steps: Cook onion and tomato, then grind smooth in the mixie. | Simmer the puree with butter, masala and salt, add paneer and cream. | Cook rotis on a tawa and serve.

Name: Coconut Chutney
Ingredients: 1/2 cup Coconut, grated | 1 Green chilli | 2 tbsp Roasted gram | Salt to taste
Steps: Grind everything in the mixie with a little water.

Name: Filter Coffee
Ingredients: 2 tbsp Coffee decoction | 1 cup Milk | 1 tsp Sugar
Steps: Boil the milk. | Mix with decoction and sugar and froth.

Name: Semiya Upma
Ingredients: 1 cup Semiya | 1 Onion, chopped | 1 Carrot, chopped | 1 tsp Mustard seeds | 1 tbsp Oil | Salt to taste
Steps: Roast semiya till golden. | Temper mustard, add onion and carrot. | Add 1.5 cups water and salt, boil, add semiya and cook till dry.

Name: Egg Bhurji with Chapati
Ingredients: 3 Eggs | 1 Onion, chopped | 1 Tomato, chopped | 1/2 tsp Chilli powder | 1 tbsp Oil | 1/2 cup Wheat flour | Salt to taste
Steps: Saute onion and tomato with chilli powder. | Add beaten eggs and scramble till cooked. | Serve with chapatis.

Name: Moong Dal Khichdi
Ingredients: 1/2 cup Rice | 1/2 cup Moong dal | 1 tsp Cumin seeds | 1/4 tsp Turmeric powder | 1 tbsp Ghee | Salt to taste
Steps: Wash rice and dal and pressure cook with turmeric, salt and 3 cups water for 3 whistles. | Temper cumin in ghee and pour over.

Name: Kara Kuzhambu
Ingredients: 10 Shallots | 1 small ball Tamarind | 2 tbsp Kuzhambu powder | 2 tbsp Sesame oil | 1 tsp Mustard seeds | Curry leaves | Salt to taste
Steps: Saute shallots in sesame oil with mustard and curry leaves. | Add tamarind water, kuzhambu powder and salt. | Simmer till thick. Serve with rice.
